home.heroSubtitle: Private chefs. Curated villas. Bespoke hospitality experiences—delivered to the world's most exclusive destinations with complete contact privacy.
home.marketplace: Our marketplace focuses on two pillars of luxury hospitality — with more experiences coming soon.
home.howItWorksSub: A seamless five-step journey from request to experience — with privacy protected at every stage.

1.title: Submit a Request
1.desc: Describe your experience — destination, dates, preferences, and budget. Takes under 5 minutes.

2.title: Providers Respond
2.desc: Our curated network reviews your request. Matching providers accept or decline within hours.

3.title: Review Your Options
3.desc: See who accepted. Browse their profiles, proposed menus, and pricing — all without revealing contact details.

4.title: Select & Pay
4.desc: Choose your provider, confirm the booking, and complete secure payment through the platform.

5.title: Contact Released
5.desc: Only after payment, direct contact information is released to both parties. Privacy guaranteed.

protection.title: Contact Protection Active
protection.desc: Provider phone numbers, email addresses, Instagram handles, and websites are hidden on all profiles. They are released exclusively after a confirmed, paid booking through this platform.

home.submit: Submit your first request in minutes. We'll handle the rest.
